title: Dev Hub for Claude Code
description: Run Claude Code sessions across many repos from one VS Code window, plus a phone-friendly web page for the same chats. Unofficial; not affiliated with Anthropic.

title: iri theme
description: A dark rose & violet theme for VS Code: deep purple surfaces, pink accents and soft pastel syntax colours.

title: Search & Debug
description: Turn native VS Code search results into line breakpoints in one click.

title: Thistle & Terrace Theme
description: Thistle purple over a sage terrace, in a light and a dark cut.

title: Pretty Python Errors
description: Make Pyright / Pylance / mypy type errors pretty and human-readable, in VS Code and in your terminal. Available in English, 繁體中文, 简体中文, 日本語 and 한국어.

title: Codex Chat Cleaner
description: Delete only current-project Codex chats, including archived chats. Busy chats are temporarily hidden with a count and automatically reappear when released.

title: Bracken & Stone Theme
description: Bracken green over pale stone, in a light and a dark cut.

title: QuotaDeck — AI Usage & Limits
description: Monitor 5-hour/weekly AI coding quotas, rate limits, and API credit balances for Antigravity, Claude Code, Codex, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Cline, and custom endpoints.

title: VSC Christmas
description: Switches the VS Code icon to a festive Christmas icon from the day after Thanksgiving through Christmas Day, then automatically reverts to default.

title: Aquarelle Studio Theme
description: Five watercolour washes: Rose, Sage, Sky, Ochre and Lilac. A pastel studio for your editor.

title: Open with VS Code
description: Open a file or folder in a new VS Code window from the Explorer context menu.

title: SVGA URL Hover Preview
description: Hover over an online .svga URL in any file to see an animated preview, with local caching.

title: Github-san tools
description: Open files and folders inside Git submodules, worktrees, and multi-root repositories on GitHub, and launch Sanskrit-aware diffs with diff_san.
